knobs.name: objects
knobs.note: box text: {class} {CLASS} {conf} {pct} {id} {x} {y} {w} {h} {v}

knobs.label: recognise things
knobs.hint: people, cars, animals and so on, 80 kinds in all; downloads about 50 MB the first time

knobs.label: confidence
knobs.hint: lower finds more, and more wrong things

knobs.label: numbers each
knobs.hint: how many tracked points on each object get a number

knobs.label: number from 1
knobs.hint: objects count up by themselves, instead of sharing the numbers of the points

knobs.name: subject
knobs.note: what moves by itself, with the camera taken out

knobs.label: ignore background
knobs.hint: at 0 the whole picture is fair game

knobs.label: ignore camera
knobs.hint: don't count the camera moving as things moving

knobs.label: sensitivity
knobs.hint: higher picks up subtler movement, and more of the wrong things

knobs.label: memory
knobs.hint: how long a subject that stops moving is kept

knobs.label: smallest
knobs.hint: as a percentage of the frame

knobs.label: show what it sees
knobs.hint: red is subject, blue is movement it decided against

knobs.name: find
knobs.note: what attracts a point

knobs.label: detail
knobs.hint: how many pixels across it looks at; higher costs more

knobs.label: reach
knobs.hint: how far a point can jump and still be the same point

knobs.label: linger
knobs.hint: frames a lost point stays on screen

knobs.label: big box style
knobs.hint: foot is a ring on the ground under it; sights runs lines out to the edges of the frame

knobs.name: labels
knobs.note: {id} {x} {y} {w} {h} {age} {v} {conf} {tag}

knobs.label: shape
knobs.hint: objects joins the big boxes to each other instead of the points

knobs.name: trails
knobs.note: where things have been

knobs.label: length
knobs.hint: in frames; 0 is none

knobs.name: patches
knobs.note: boxes filled with something

knobs.name: overlay text
knobs.note: {rec} {clock} {date} {n} {regions} {counts} {list} {frame} {fps} {file}

knobs.name: layers
knobs.note: what's followed changes the picture itself: the things, and the rest of the world, each made into something else through a soft-edged shape

knobs.label: the world
knobs.hint: what everything that isn't followed becomes; dither and halftone use the look's shadow and highlight colours as ink and paper; sorted smears its bright runs into streaks

knobs.label: how much
knobs.hint: how far the world goes toward that

knobs.label: the things
knobs.hint: what the things followed become; untouched leaves them as shot, before the look's colour

knobs.label: flat colour
knobs.hint: the colour things become when they're flat

knobs.label: sort above
knobs.hint: sorted: how bright a run of pixels must be to be sorted; lower smears more

knobs.label: sort
knobs.hint: sorted: down the picture, or across it

knobs.label: dot size
knobs.hint: halftone and dither: how big the dots are

knobs.label: crushed
knobs.hint: crushed: how badly the JPEG's saved, 1 at quality 1 (blocks, rings, colour smeared)

knobs.label: bent
knobs.hint: stride: how far off the row width is (past half, a byte late too, so the colours turn); bits: how few are left, and how many bands go wrong

knobs.label: shape from
knobs.hint: outline: each thing's true shape, from EdgeTAM on the graphics card; cutout: what in each box doesn't look like what's around it; boxes: a rounded shape in each box; movement: the shape of what moved, coarser; both: cutout and movement

knobs.label: softness
knobs.hint: how soft the shape's edge is

knobs.label: grow
knobs.hint: swell the shape out, or draw it in

knobs.label: contour
knobs.hint: a line along the shape's edge

knobs.label: sonar rings
knobs.hint: rings spreading out from the things across the world, as from a ping

knobs.label: ring speed
knobs.hint: how fast they spread; 0 holds them still

knobs.name: echo
knobs.note: time in the picture: the things followed leave copies of themselves behind, smear like a long exposure, or show only what moved

knobs.label: echo
knobs.hint: how many copies are left behind (0 is none); for exposure and extract, how long the effect lasts

knobs.label: every
knobs.hint: seconds between copies; for extract, how far back the picture it's laid over is

knobs.label: fade
knobs.hint: how much the oldest copies have faded; for extract, how much of it there is

knobs.label: kind
knobs.hint: copies: crisp cut-outs; ghosts: faint grey ones; exposure: a long exposure of the things alone; extract: what's still turns grey and only what moved shows; slit: a slit-scan, each row of the world a moment further back than the one above it (over copies times how often), the things as they are now

knobs.name: insets
knobs.note: magnified live crops of the things followed, docked along one edge, each with a caption and a line out to the thing

knobs.label: insets
knobs.hint: how many (0 is none); as many as fit

knobs.label: size
knobs.hint: each cell's side, as a share of the frame's shorter side

knobs.label: zoom
knobs.hint: 1 fits the whole thing in its cell; more closes in on its middle

knobs.label: caption
knobs.hint: {id} {class} {CLASS} {pct} {w} {h} {x} {y} {zoom}

knobs.name: glyphs
knobs.note: the picture as characters, picked by brightness, in the look's font

knobs.label: glyphs
knobs.hint: where: over the things followed, the world around them, or all of it; words: the picture becomes paper and each thing is typed out as its name, filling its shape

knobs.label: size
knobs.hint: a character's height, as if the frame were 1080 high

knobs.label: characters
knobs.hint: darkest to brightest

knobs.label: picture's colours
knobs.hint: ink each character in the picture's own colour there

knobs.label: label the world
knobs.hint: words: type the world as what it is (sky, sea, tree, road…), from SegFormer on the graphics card

knobs.label: the world as
knobs.hint: words: what the world is typed as; empty leaves it paper

knobs.label: world's ink
knobs.hint: words: how strongly the world is typed beside the things; darker parts of the picture are typed harder

knobs.name: depth
knobs.note: how far away each part of the picture is (Depth Anything V2 on the graphics card), and what that does to it

knobs.label: depth
knobs.hint: fog: far things fade into the colour; slices: lines where the scene crosses each of a set of depths; sweep: a band of depth sweeping far to near and back; focus: a lens pulling focus to the main thing followed, everything nearer or farther softening

knobs.label: slices
knobs.hint: how many depths get a line

knobs.label: sweep time
knobs.hint: seconds to sweep far to near and back

knobs.name: looking ahead
knobs.note: exports go over the whole clip with the detector first, so things are there from the first frame they're seen, end where the footage cuts, and boxes don't lag; the preview does too once it's looked

knobs.label: look ahead
knobs.hint: off follows things as they come, the cautious way the site has to

knobs.label: smoothing
knobs.hint: seconds boxes are smoothed over, both ways in time: 0 is the detector's own boxes, higher is steadier

knobs.name: camera
knobs.note: follow cam: a virtual camera that keeps what's followed in frame, for turning a landscape clip into a 9:16 one. Pick a shape to export at; with picked things it follows them, otherwise the main thing

knobs.label: follow
knobs.hint: move the frame with what's followed

knobs.label: zoom
knobs.hint: 0 keeps the frame as big as it goes; higher closes in until the thing fills more of it

knobs.label: smoothness
knobs.hint: seconds the camera takes to settle: low is quick and nervous, high is slow and steady

knobs.name: slow motion
knobs.note: slowed down, exports make the frames between with RIFE on the graphics card, so the movement stays smooth rather than each frame showing again, in the preview too

knobs.label: speed
knobs.hint: under 1 is slow motion

knobs.label: smooth
knobs.hint: make the frames between rather than showing each again

knobs.name: reveal
knobs.note: the picture as it was against the look: side by side, in quick cuts between them, or the things (or the world) left as they were

knobs.label: reveal
knobs.hint: split: the left as it was; sweep: that line sweeping across and back; flick: hard cuts to the picture as it was; things: the things as they were, the look round them; world: the reverse

knobs.label: how much
knobs.hint: split and sweep: how far across; flick: how much of each beat shows the picture as it was; things and world: how strongly

knobs.label: beat
knobs.hint: flick: seconds a beat; sweep: seconds across and back

knobs.label: irregular
knobs.hint: flick: 0 cuts on every beat; higher skips and holds beats, like a hand on the cut

knobs.name: mix
knobs.note: another look drawn over the same clip and put together with this one: right-click (or shift-click) a look on the left to mix it in

knobs.label: with
knobs.hint: the other look: right-click or shift-click one on the left

knobs.label: how
knobs.hint: things: the other look on the things; world: on the rest; over: the other look's marks (boxes, labels, text, insets) on top of this whole look, untouched by it; under: this look's marks on top of the other's whole picture; split: the other on the left; sweep: that line sweeping across and back; flick: hard cuts between them (on the beat, with beat on); blend: one over the other; lighter: the lighter of the two

knobs.label: how much
knobs.hint: things and world: how strongly; split and sweep: how far across; flick: how much of each beat is the other look; blend: how much of the other

knobs.label: beat
knobs.hint: flick: seconds a beat (without the music's); sweep: seconds across and back

knobs.label: irregular
knobs.hint: flick: 0 cuts on every beat; higher skips and holds some

knobs.name: glitch
knobs.note: broken video on purpose: the picture dragged along by its own motion (datamosh, drawn or for real), a worn tape, colours from three moments, a skipping buffer, a kaleidoscope round what's followed

knobs.label: datamosh
knobs.hint: the picture pushed along by its own motion rather than drawn again, as a video plays with its key frames lost. Drawn: always (blocks come back now and then), or on cuts. Real: the clip re-encoded and its key frames taken out at its cuts, or a frame's motion played over and over on the beats (a few seconds to make, then kept)

knobs.label: on
knobs.hint: moshed: all of the picture, the world round the things, or the things

knobs.label: hold
knobs.hint: on cuts: seconds the last shot's held and pushed about; always: about how long a block lasts before it's drawn again

knobs.label: tape
knobs.hint: a worn tape: rows wobbling, a tracking tear rolling down, colour bleeding, scanlines

knobs.label: trichrome
knobs.hint: seconds between red, green and blue: what's still keeps its colours, what moves splits into three

knobs.label: stutter
knobs.hint: a skipping buffer: the chance each beat (with beat on), or about how often a second, that a few frames loop

knobs.label: frames
knobs.hint: how many frames a stutter loops

knobs.label: kaleidoscope
knobs.hint: how many mirrored wedges (0 is off), round the biggest thing on show

knobs.label: turning
knobs.hint: the kaleidoscope's turns a minute (negative the other way)

knobs.name: beat
knobs.note: on the music: flicks cut, copies are taken and sonar rings pulse on the clip's beats, found in its sound

knobs.label: on the beat
knobs.hint: flick, copies and sonar rings follow the music's beats rather than a steady time

knobs.label: every
knobs.hint: every beat, every second, every fourth…

knobs.name: foresight
knobs.note: where each thing is going: its path over the next few seconds and where it ends up, from looking ahead (only spotter can know)

knobs.label: seconds ahead
knobs.hint: how far ahead to draw each thing's path; 0 is off
